components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: inherit; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #e8a04a 45%, #2f3b4a); background: #232d3a; color: #ffe3b5; padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9fd4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Stop — abort phase, no merge, sessions left for attach.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font: inherit; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #e05a5a 50%, #2f3b4a); background: #232d3a; color: #ffc9c9; padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9fd4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.css: .ds-project { background: #1a222c; border: 1px solid #2f3b4a; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem 1rem; color: #e8eef4; font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-project h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-path { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-family: "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #8b9aab; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Running / attention / failed / paused / idle micro-label.
components.css: .ds-pill { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.18rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-running { background: color-mix(in srgb, #3dba7a 22%, transparent); color: #9df0c0; }

components.name: Failure Artifact
components.description: Hard-fail path, class, merge block, toast note.
components.css: .ds-artifact { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #e05a5a 45%, #2f3b4a); border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #e05a5a 8%, #232d3a); padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; color: #f0c0c0; font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-artifact h3 { margin: 0 0 0.35rem; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #ffb0b0; } .ds-v { margin: 0; font-family: "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; }

narrative.overview: Coordinator’s Status Surface is an Operate product: dense enough for concurrent harness phases, calm enough for hours-long autonomous runs. Cool industrial neutrals with a scarce attention accent; flat tonal layering; Windows-native sans + Cascadia Mono.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral base with a single decisive accent
Monospace for IDs/paths; humanist sans for chrome

rules.name: The One Alarm Rule
rules.body: Accent color is for state that requires operator attention or a primary action—not section decoration.

rules.name: The No Purple Gradient Rule
rules.body: Reject default AI-dashboard purple-to-blue gradients and glassmorphism glow stacks.

rules.name: The Scan Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Status tables and phase lists must remain readable at a glance.

rules.name: The Status Board Rule
rules.body: Default view answers track, phase, harness roles, failure without hunting nested cards.

rules.name: The Flat Console Rule
rules.body: Do not nest cards inside cards; use spacing, separators, and row selection.

dos: Do design for operator scan paths: track → phase → harness → failure class.
Do keep Stop/Pause and hard-failure presentation unmistakable.
Do leave room for monospaced IDs without breaking layout.
Do map new UI colors to live :root variables.
donts: Don't use generic AI SaaS template aesthetics.
Don't invent cloud multi-tenant ops framing.
Don't bury Stop/Pause or failure state.
Don't reintroduce seed placeholders for fixed tokens.
